body:
1. In bin/hook-runner.sh emit_fallback(), set UNPARSEABLE=1 when stdin file TMP_IN is empty/missing so child failures with empty stdin fail closed to deny. Add test in test/hook-runner.test.mjs.
2. In bin/node-launcher.sh is_trusted_candidate(), resolve REAL_HOME via resolve_full_path and accept candidates under either HOME or REAL_HOME. Add test in test/node-launcher.test.mjs.
3. Set chmod +x on bin/node-launcher.sh (100755).
title: Wave 2: Fail-closed empty stdin in hook-runner.sh and symlinked HOME support in node-launcher.sh
